about: Factorio 2.1.24, the sample agricultural science build (five biochambers: machine:1 and machine:2 make nutrients, machine:3 and machine:4 pentapod eggs, machine:5 the science; 12 stack inserters), clock 3450755e (period 480 ticks), staged start; samples 2400 to 7679 of a run of 7680 (tick 0 here is sample 2400; counted from tick 480, periods 6 to 15). Series as recorded; true_starts: the ticks a machine consumed ingredients (its ingredients and fuel fell by more than the fuel item its burner took, net of what its feeders dropped), fuel_taken: its burner took a fuel item (burning_remaining rose), fuel_put_in: an inserter put fuel into it; woken_by_machine: the ticks the game woke the inserter from a machine's list, read in the running game, with the cause.

clock.about: the build and its clock (3450755e) as the generator exports them: windows by inserter, 0-based clock positions; the config is the sample's, with the 84 eggs each egg machine took at the staged start as its loop seed; simulated from that start (warmup_periods 0), the simulator's tick t is the fixture's tick t + 4 - 2400
